entity: ΚΗΡΥΞ Α.Ε. (Kiryx S.A.), publisher of the Chania newspaper Κήρυξ (Kirykas)
period: declared for fiscal year 2024 and in earlier declarations
detail: CNN Greece and To Vima list a holding in ΚΗΡΥΞ Α.Ε.; SKAI and Fortune Greece describe it as shares in the Chania newspaper Κήρυκας Χανίων. The size of the stake is not reported. Greek MPs file an annual asset declaration (δήλωση περιουσιακής κατάστασης, 'pothen esches') that the Hellenic Parliament's audit committee publishes on hellenicparliament.gr; that site was not readable for this research (access denied to the harvest), so the figures are taken from press reports that cite the declaration. The separate declaration of his spouse is not reproduced.
